attributes.content: Sorting Non-Identical Objects: Jamie sorted toys, utensils, and clothing into 3 bins for 10 minutes. She got 13 out of 15 correct — mixed up a spoon into the toys bin once, and hesitated on a sock. Stayed focused the full 10 minutes.
attributes.reasoning: Jamie completed the sorting activity as described in the Math block, sorting objects into categories for the specified duration.
attributes.matchedBlock: Math: Sort non-identical objects into 3 categories (e.g., toys, utensils, clothing) for 10 minutes. Use ABLLS-R B12 materials.
